card.name: Withhold in dose-modification tables
card.fires_on: The piece "hold" in "Withhold" at the start of an action cell in a dose-modification table, right after a lab or toxicity grade criterion. Also fires once on a stray Lao script character.

modes.label: Withhold action cell
modes.description: "hold" completing "Withhold" after a lab value or adverse reaction grade, before the drug name or "until".
